trigger: Stage 1 found moderate long-term log-log coupling but weak first-difference coupling; Stage 2 found no common threshold acceleration.
question: Does effective breeding-component contraction track current abundance, a short trailing abundance average, or the deepest abundance bottleneck experienced so far?

candidate_predictors_frozen_before_compu.trailing3: x_t = -log(GM of current and previous two observed N values / N_first); use available prior observations for the first two seasons

model: For each candidate fit y = k*x through the origin with equal total weight per population.
comparison: Leave one entire population trajectory out; fit on four, predict the fifth; compare equal-weight mean held-out population RMSE.
memory_rule: Call historical-bottleneck memory a candidate only if running_min has lower equal-weight LOO RMSE than both current and trailing3.
interpretation_rules: Exploratory only; cannot alter the frozen Ecology Report.
A running-minimum win suggests path dependence or structural persistence, not individual-level memory or causal hysteresis.
No lag length beyond the frozen trailing3 model may be searched.
Calendar time is a secular-trend benchmark, not an ecological mechanism.
Five population units are nested within two monitoring systems.
